findings.evidence: `TauCeti/Topology/Category/TopCommRingCat/CompleteSeparated.lean:85-89` deliberately records the same completion statement only as an `example`, explaining that callers should apply `isCompleteSeparated_of_completeSpace_of_t0Space` directly; the new theorem’s proof at lines 73-77 does exactly that.
findings.fix: Remove this theorem and construct `completionLocObj` directly as already done; callers needing the predicate can install the localization instances and apply `isCompleteSeparated_of_completeSpace_of_t0Space`.
findings.issue: `isCompleteSeparated_completion_locTopology` is a named special case of the already-public general completion theorem, duplicating the API without being used by `completionLocObj`.

summary: The packaged object is at the roadmap’s natural level, but the accompanying predicate theorem duplicates an existing general completion result.
